Source-specific reservation and lock controls permit at most one running job per source.

A source lock without a live source task or queued/running job is orphaned.
Enabled sources with an implemented adapter are covered by the one-minute due-source dispatcher.
A recurring source window is missed only when its interval plus two dispatcher ticks elapsed without a job, active job, Redis lock/reservation, or global pause.
